overview.text: The Eastern Black-tailed Rattlesnake is a venomous rattlesnake of Texas, New Mexico and northern Mexico. It was long included in the Black-tailed Rattlesnake (*Crotalus molossus*) until it was recognised again as a separate species in 2012.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: Texas and New Mexico in the USA, and Chihuahua, Coahuila, Nuevo León and Zacatecas in Mexico.
